dct_description_sm:
This layer features the locations of Ferry Docks within the City of Kingston. Winter and Summer season docking locations are differentiated. Ferry docks area classified as critical facilities for transportation and used for emergency planning.

Data source: Points of Interest

For more information about transportation, including ferry routes and fares, please visit the city's website.
